newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen,Eurodollars end flat in skimpy trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen,Eurodollars end flat in skimpy trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Eurodollar futures ended scarcely changed after fluctuating no more than two ticks on meagre turnover on Thursday.
Dealers said a Japanese holiday and anticipation of U.S. wholesale inflation and retail sales data on Friday dampened market participation.
March Eurodollars ended at 94.25 after testing a high of 94.27 against an IMM close at 94.25.

"Last night's drop (in Chicago) took some people by surprise so there was a bit of covering," said a dealer with a U.S. house. "But we've had a significant rally over the last few weeks so we should see some correction."

U.S. treasuries closed lower overnight on technical selling, fresh corporate supply and comments by a top Federal Reserve official who said sustaining the fight against inflation could entail a temporary rise in interest rates in the future.
December and March Euroyen finished at 99.42 and 99.32 against their IMM closes at 99.41 and 99.32 respectively. Volume for both months was a mere 1780 lots.
"There's something of a consolidation in Euroyen. March has been holding just above 99.30, but it looks inflated in my opinion," said the dealer.
He said March could come off to 99.27, but added, "There hasn't been any talk of rate action by the Bank of Japan so the medium-term trend is still upwards."
Japanese government bond futures were not traded due to the holiday in Japan.
